train.via: Phnom Penh Station to Kampot station

bus.via: Phnom Penh CTT Transports to Kampot CTT Transports

trips.route_note: Direct buses or shared taxis take about 3-4 hours from Phnom Penh to Kampot; a very early departure is needed for a same-day return.
trips.tour_query: Kampot day trip from Phnom Penh
trips.why: The bus takes 2h30 directly, much quicker than the 4h42 train.
know: Start early to allow a same-day return
Riverside and Bokor area are the main draws

train.via: Phnom Penh Station to Sihanoukville station

bus.via: Phnom Penh Virak Buntham Express to Sihanoukville Virak Buntham Express

trips.route_note: Buses run directly from Phnom Penh to Sihanoukville in about 4-5 hours on National Road 4; this is a long but doable return trip only if you leave very early.
trips.tour_query: Sihanoukville beach day trip from Phnom Penh
trips.why: The bus is the fastest option at 3h and runs directly, while the train takes over 6h30.
know: Leave very early for a same-day return
Beach town gets crowded on weekends and holidays

bus.via: Phnom Penh Virak Buntham to Kampong Cham Virak Buntham

trips.route_note: Buses run directly from Phnom Penh to Kampong Cham in roughly 2.5-3 hours along National Road 6/7.
trips.tour_query: Kampong Cham day trip from Phnom Penh
trips.why: A direct 2h bus is fast and simple for this short run.
know: Early start needed for a comfortable return
